claims: BYD stands for Build Your Dreams.
BYD overtook Tesla in 2025 as the top EV seller.
BYD uses Blade Batteries.
BYD offers compact models with prices starting around $24,000.
BYD Dolphin is a hatchback.
BYD Dolphin Mini is a compact.
BYD Atto 3 is a compact crossover.
BYD Sealion 7 is an SUV.
BYD Tang is a 7-seater SUV.
BYD Seal is a sedan.
BYD Han is a sedan.
BYD Seal U DM-i is a plug-in hybrid.
BYD Sealion 5 DM-i is a plug-in hybrid.
BYD has a new pickup truck currently undergoing testing.
BYD's Blade Battery features LFP chemistry.
BYD AT1 is a small car.
BYD AT1 is priced as low as $23,990 (plus on-road costs) in some markets.
BYD does not currently sell passenger cars in the United States due to high tariffs and regulatory concerns.
BYD was founded in 2003.
BYD was originally a battery manufacturer.
BYD stopped internal combustion engine vehicle production in 2022.
